_about: Scene 2 extract. LOCKED prefixes copied verbatim from the Drive bibles; the Dances neck-tattoo clause is appended from the Dances Drift Log correction (F2-02).

cinematography_prefix.text: Cinematic tearjerker tone, emotionally intimate framing, soft natural light favoring dawn or dusk. Foil visible somewhere in frame — crumpled, glinting, or scattered nearby. Environment shows worn signs of habitation — blankets, bags, makeshift bedding — treated with visual dignity, not disorder. Camera lingers rather than cuts quickly, allowing emotional weight to build.

blocking_prefix.text: Composition follows dynamic symmetry principles — subject(s) positioned along a diagonal sightline rather than center-frame, with deliberate negative space.

rules: Describe drug items as objects (small blue pills, foil) — never name the substance in visual prompt text

global_negatives: no dead-center framing unless flagged as intentional
no clean or brand-new camping gear; tents show wear and dust
no high-contrast plastic or neon garbage bins

variants.present_day: [DANCES] Same character as reference image: 22-year-old woman, mixed Cherokee and Black heritage, warm brown skin, high cheekbones, dark almond eyes, hard unimpressed expression, thick dark hair in two thick braids, tribal tattoos on both arms and neck only (no facial tattoos), worn brown leather jacket, gray tank top, dark jeans, boots. Neck tattoo limited to the left side of the neck only, small feather design, does not extend past the collarbone, no chest tattoo. Scene:

no thin/multi-braid hairstyle, two thick braids only

CHURCH_STOOP.text: The Salinas Confucius Church: ornate red-tiled roof, decorative red trim, tan stucco walls, columned entrance with dark wooden double doors, church signage above the entrance door, a utility pole and street lamp nearby. On the church stoop, a small blue tent with a blue tarp draped over it sits on the left side (Dances' tent), and a light tan tent with no tarp sits on the right side (Brandon's tent).
negatives: no swapping tent positions: Dances' blue tent always left, Brandon's tan tent always right
no clean or brand-new camping gear

ELONGATED_FOIL.text: a single unusually long strip of foil, roughly 4 inches wide and 16 inches long, laid out flat, catching the early light — long and mostly flat, unusually elongated compared to typical crumpled foil

TORCH_LIGHTER.source: Script: 'the piece of foil and torch she'd dropped'
TORCH_LIGHTER.text: a small handheld butane torch lighter lying on its side

SLOBBER_STRING.text: a continuous, glistening string of saliva from the corner of her mouth, stretching down to a small reflective puddle on the cold step

FADED_PHOTO.text: a small curled-corner photograph half-tucked under the edge of a step

WORN_BLANKET.text: a bundled worn blanket in muted neutral tones beside the church entrance

WEATHERED_BACKPACK.text: a single worn, aged backpack resting beside the blanket
